issues.title: [Bug] 限制历史消息数功能逻辑缺陷
issues.body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

v1.38.0

### 💻 系统环境

macOS

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

限制历史消息数功能打开时，设置为0应当是没有上下文，而不是不限制上下文数量。

现在实际上当启用限制功能时，最低为0，代码逻辑在：
lobehub/lobe-chat/src/app/(main)/chat/(workspace)/@conversation/features/ChatList/ChatItem/index.tsx [68:75]
  const enableHistoryDivider = useAgentStore((s) => {
    const config = agentSelectors.currentAgentChatConfig(s);
    return (
      config.enableHistoryCount &&
      historyLength > (config.historyCount ?? 0) &&
      config.historyCount === historyLength - index
    );
  });
可以看到限制为0时，会始终返回false

### 📷 复现步骤

启用一个话题时，启用限制历史消息数功能，设置限制为0即可复现

### 🚦 期望结果

当启用限制历史消息数功能，且限制为0时，限制应当如下：

user: A
AI：B
---结束对话
user:new A
AI: new B

issues.title: [Request] 希望支持deepseek新模型deepseek-r1的api接口
issues.body:
### 🥰 需求描述

目前问题：
向api请求时返回
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request_error",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": null,
    "message": "deepseek-reasoner does not support the parameter `presence_penalty`"
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
  "provider": "deepseek"
}


### 🧐 解决方案

可能是由于lobe请求自带presence_penalty等参数导致，删除后应该就可以了。

temperature、top_p、presence_penalty、frequency_penalty、logprobs、top_logprobs都不可以存在。

官方文档显示：

> API 参数
> 
>     输入参数：
>         max_tokens：最终回答的最大长度（不含思维链输出），默认为 4K，最大为 8K。请注意，思维链的输出最多可以达到 32K tokens，控思维链的长度的参数（reasoning_effort）将会在近期上线。
> 
>     输出字段：
>         reasoning_content：思维链内容，与 content 同级，访问方法见[访问样例](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/reasoning_model#%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E6%A0%B7%E4%BE%8B)
>         content：最终回答内容
> 
>     上下文长度：API 最大支持 64K 上下文，输出的 reasoning_content 长度不计入 64K 上下文长度中
> 
>     支持的功能：[对话补全](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/api/create-chat-completion)，[对话前缀续写 (Beta)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/chat_prefix_completion)
> 
>     不支持的功能：Function Call、Json Output、FIM 补全 (Beta)
> 
>     不支持的参数：temperature、top_p、presence_penalty、frequency_penalty、logprobs、top_logprobs

### 📝 补充信息

无

linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: fix reasoning output for OpenRouter reasoning models like deepseek-r1
linked_prs.body:
## 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

- [x ] ✨ feat


## 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

### Business Description
Get reasoning (i.e. deep thinking) outputs for all OpenRouter reasoning models, and display them in lobe-chat UI.

Fully tested: unittests as well as integration testing.

### Technical Description
Unlike most other DeepSeek-R1 providers which simply return `<think> ... </think>` inside reply messages. OpenRouter use a separate `"reasoning"` key to return reasoning outputs. Besides it requires add `include_reasoning=True` in payload. [See their docs](https://openrouter.ai/announcements/reasoning-tokens-for-thinking-models).

**Therefore, to support it we need two changes:**
1. Set `include_reasoning=True` by using `handlePayload` callback. This does not affect non-reasoning models at all. Verification:
    -you could see reasoning outputs in response:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07110e77-7bff-4255-894e-69d8eca4313f)
2. Transform the response stream from 
```
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': None, 'reasoning': 'Okay'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'start-content', 'reasoning': ''}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'foo bar', 'reasoning': ''}
```
to 
```
{'role': 'assistant', 'content':  '<think>Okay'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '</think>start-content'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'foo bar'}
```

This transformed content is consistent with other platforms - a single 'content' stream of thinking then normal output tokens. Therefore, the <think> part gets automatically picked up and displayed.

Verification:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0829849c-14c7-47ee-8cf3-4e2dd31ab3fd)


#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

Solves #5766 , related #5860

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves the OpenRouter's `deepseek/deepseek-r1:free` model, which is an LLM model, and concerns its reasoning content display. This aligns with the "Unsupported models" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: fix reasoning output for OpenRouter reasoning models like deepseek-r1
linked_prs.body:
## 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

- [x ] ✨ feat


## 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

### Business Description
Get reasoning (i.e. deep thinking) outputs for all OpenRouter reasoning models, and display them in lobe-chat UI.

Fully tested: unittests as well as integration testing.

### Technical Description
Unlike most other DeepSeek-R1 providers which simply return `<think> ... </think>` inside reply messages. OpenRouter use a separate `"reasoning"` key to return reasoning outputs. Besides it requires add `include_reasoning=True` in payload. [See their docs](https://openrouter.ai/announcements/reasoning-tokens-for-thinking-models).

**Therefore, to support it we need two changes:**
1. Set `include_reasoning=True` by using `handlePayload` callback. This does not affect non-reasoning models at all. Verification:
    -you could see reasoning outputs in response:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07110e77-7bff-4255-894e-69d8eca4313f)
2. Transform the response stream from 
```
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': None, 'reasoning': 'Okay'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'start-content', 'reasoning': ''}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'foo bar', 'reasoning': ''}
```
to 
```
{'role': 'assistant', 'content':  '<think>Okay'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '</think>start-content'}
{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'foo bar'}
```

This transformed content is consistent with other platforms - a single 'content' stream of thinking then normal output tokens. Therefore, the <think> part gets automatically picked up and displayed.

Verification:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0829849c-14c7-47ee-8cf3-4e2dd31ab3fd)


#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

Solves #5766 , related #5860

issues.title: [Request] Add Support for NVIDIA NIM API Platform Integration
issues.body:
### 🥰 Problem Description  
NVIDIA NIM APIs provides a hosted service (`build.nvidia.com`) for deploying open-source models on high-performance NVIDIA GPUs, enabling developers to leverage optimized inference endpoints via APIs. Currently, LobeChat supports multiple inference providers but lacks integration with NVIDIA NIM.  

Adding NIM APIs support would allow users to:  
1. Deploy models efficiently on NVIDIA-optimized infrastructure  
2. Access popular open-source models (e.g., Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek-R1) via NIM's managed service  
3. Reduce self-hosting costs/complexity for GPU-based inference  

### 🧐 Suggested Implementation  
1. Add "NVIDIA NIM" provider option in model settings  
2. Configuration fields:  
   - `API Key` (NVIDIA API key)  
   - `Endpoint URL` (NIM deployment endpoint)  
   - `Model List` (auto-populate available models)  

### 📝 Note: DeepSeek-R1 Thinking Protocal Handling
The NIM-deployed DeepSeek-R1 model directly outputs `<think>` formatting blocks in the responses field. These special markers need post-processing adaptation in LobeChat.

### 📄 References

- [NVIDIA NIM LLM APIs Reference](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/llm-apis)
- [NVIDIA NIM deepseek-r1 Reference](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/deepseek-ai-deepseek-r1)

issues.title: [Bug] `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` Ollama Failures
issues.body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

1.52.11

### 💻 Operating System

Other Linux

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

Basically, Ollama's `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` is not functioning at all from a long time ago.
There was an attempt to fix Ollama issue in #5665, and it closes a bunch of Ollama issues. However this fix is in wrong direction. Ollama report various embedding and usage failures because no matter how `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` is configured, **the backend server somehow still uses `127.0.0.1` to look for it for embedding and other backend services.**

The fix done in #5665 is simply displaying a fetch model input in "connection check" UI, and even this field is not functioning with Ollama pointing to `127.0.0.1` instead of `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL`.

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Under any circumstances that Ollama's `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` is different from `127.0.0.1`, embedding will fail. "Connectivity Check" is till using `127.0.0.1` to communicate to Ollama backend. #5665 failed to fix this issue.

#2266 #2327 #3100 #5634 #5625 #5409 #3423 #3620 #4413 #5610 needs to be re-fixed.

A lot of open issues with Ollama is also caused by this **ineffective** `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` env variable:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20ollama

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

issues.title: [Bug] Azure OpenAI o-series 模型不支持 system role，导致报错
issues.body:
### 📦 部署环境

Docker

### 📌 软件版本

v1.55.3

### 💻 系统环境

Windows

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

当使用 Azure OpenAI 的 O-series 模型（如 `o1`, `o1-mini` 等）时，如果设定了 `system prompt` 会导致以下错误：

```
"error": {
  "message": "Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'system' with this model.",
  "type": "invalid_request_error",
  "param": "messages[0].role",
  "code": "unsupported_value"
}
```

根据 Azure OpenAI 的模型支持文档，O-series 模型不支持 `system` 这个角色，因此传递带有 `system` role 的消息时会报错。

### 📷 复现步骤

1. 在 LobeChat 中配置 O-series 模型（如 `o1-mini`）。
2. 设置一个 `system prompt`。
3. 触发聊天请求，就会看到上述错误。

### 🚦 期望结果

对于O-series模型，将`system`切换成`user`或者`developer`。
可以参考[openai/index.ts中的这段代码](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/3e8d9c56a790bd36f81d1561b5c38488f9c9d252/src/libs/agent-runtime/openai/index.ts#L28-L33)进行修正。

### 📝 补充信息

这个问题应仅涉及 O-series 模型，如果使用其他支持 `system` role 的模型（例如标准的 `gpt-4o`），不需要进行此类处理。

issues.title: 使用 OpenAI o1-pro、gpt-4o-search、gpt-4o-mini-search 模型會出現錯誤訊息。
issues.body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

client pgelite db (lobe-chat-pglite image)

### 📌 Version

最新版本

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

以下為三則 OpenAI API 測試訊息與其對應的錯誤內容

---

## 測試訊息與錯誤內容整理

1. **o1-pro 測試訊息**
   ```json
   {
     "error": {
       "code": null,
       "type": "invalid_request_error",
       "param": "model",
       "message": "This is not a chat model and thus not supported in the v1/chat/completions endpoint. Did you mean to use v1/completions?"
     },
     "endpoint": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
     "provider": "openai"
   }
   ```
   **錯誤說明：**  
   - 回傳訊息顯示該 model 不支援 `v1/chat/completions` 端點，應使用 `v1/completions`。

2. **gpt-4o-search-preview 測試訊息**
   ```json
   {
     "error": {
       "code": null,
       "type": "invalid_request_error",
       "param": null,
       "message": "Model incompatible request arguments supplied: frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, temperature, top_p"
     },
     "endpoint": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
     "provider": "openai"
   }
   ```
   **錯誤說明：**  
   - 回傳訊息顯示傳入的參數（如 `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, `temperature`, `top_p`）與該模型不相容。

3. **gpt-4o-mini-search-preview 測試訊息**
   ```json
   {
     "error": {
       "code": null,
       "type": "invalid_request_error",
       "param": null,
       "message": "Model incompatible request arguments supplied: frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, temperature, top_p"
     },
     "endpoint": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
     "provider": "openai"
   }
   ```
   **錯誤說明：**  
   - 與上條相同，傳入的 `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, `temperature`, `top_p` 等參數不受該模型支援。

---

## 建議與後續處理方式

- **o1-pro**  
  - 若要使用非 Chat 型的模型，請改用 `v1/completions` 端點。
  
- **gpt-4o-search-preview / gpt-4o-mini-search-preview**  
  - 請確認該模型所支援的參數，將不相容的參數（如 `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`, `temperature`, `top_p`）移除或調整。

linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: Google Gemini tools declarations
linked_prs.body:
#### 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

<!-- For change type, change [ ] to [x]. -->

- [ ] ✨ feat
- [x] 🐛 fix
- [ ] ♻️ refactor
- [ ] 💄 style
- [ ] 👷 build
- [ ] ⚡️ perf
- [ ] 📝 docs
- [ ] 🔨 chore

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

- 根据[官方文档](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/function-calling)调整响应使用 `{ functionResponse: { name: tool_call.name, response: { result } }` 格式
- functionCall 的 role 修改为 `model`
- 已经存在 tool_calls (已经调用过 FunctionCall) 时，也需要声明 `tools`，否则，会导致后续调用不正常
- 生成 `ToolCallId` 添加随机数，解决多次调用与响应不匹配的问题，解决后续 functionResponse 无法正确返回的问题

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

使用 Gemini + Function Call(联网搜索/MCP...) 时，经常会出现调用 tool 出错。开始以为是模型问题，后来试了不管是 2.5 Flash-Lite 、2.5-Flash 还是 2.5 Pro 都会报错。

可能关联的 issues:

- close #7902
- close #7298

#### 实际问题举例

**多次调用的情况(ToolCallId 未修正时)**

第一次调用，问题不大:

![gemini-1st-msgs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/323cce70-1168-47fb-aa86-42f9c4fbbb4c)
![gemini-1st-call](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7680b47-c0a2-4ebf-ae9f-c1bf2add8958)

❗第二次就有问题了:

![gemini-2nd-msgs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/914ea795-73ad-4172-8c1e-7d070fbdbd07)

最后一条 message 应该是 role: tool 的，但是到 assistant 就没了

![gemini-2nd-call](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d0a9643-5a7f-425d-b99f-ef219ca75a2d)

导致模型直接返回空响应:

![gemini-2nd-resp](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/461189bc-bd28-49ba-9a21-1d44cb87d742)

**而且因为 ToolCallId 的重复，显示也会异常**

第一次调用正确的应该是 Vercel AI 相关的结果:

![first-mcp-tool-results](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1150115a-f2dd-42e3-b054-183cf7a91339)

经过第二次调用之后，前面第一次的“返回结果”变成了第二次的结果:

![second-mcp-tool-results](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e93ea3fd-4bd7-4faa-971a-bf72403ea45d)

而且会导致不停调用 tools:

![duplicate-tool-calls](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d4411aea-4179-42d0-afb3-19e10d744853)

## Summary by Sourcery

Fix Google Gemini tools integration by correcting message conversion, ensuring tool declarations persist, and preventing tool-call ID collisions

Bug Fixes:
- Convert tool responses to functionResponse parts with proper result wrapping
- Use 'model' role for functionCall messages instead of 'function'
- Always declare tools even when past function calls exist to maintain subsequent call behavior
- Add randomness to generated ToolCallId to avoid ID collisions across multiple calls

Enhancements:
- Extract helper buildFunctionDeclarations to centralize tool declaration logic

Tests:
- Add unit test to verify correct conversion of function response messages

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The error message indicates a problem with function call sequencing, which is likely related to tool invocation or workflow anomalies in the agent system, aligning with the taxonomy of agent issues.

issues.title: [Request] Allow uploading images for tool calls with non-vision models
issues.body:
### 🥰 需求描述

目前，LobeChat 只允许具备 Vision 能力的模型上传图片。如果模型没有声明 vision 能力，用户无法上传或粘贴图片。但在一些实际场景下，用户希望上传图片的目的是传递给工具使用，并不需要模型识别图片内容。

实际案例：本地通过vllm部署qwen3-30b-a3b模型（该模型支持调用工具，但Vision能力），通过Dify创建ComfyUI工作流并转变为MCP服务，在LobeChat中以MCP的方式安装该插件，即可以通过调用工具的形式处理用户上传的图片。因此，需要允许该模型上传图片或粘贴图片，通过工具将上传的图片 URL 作为参数传递给Dify工作流，而不是通过 image_url 发送到模型 API。

当前的行为限制了此类工具链的使用场景。

### 🧐 解决方案

允许所有模型开启图片上传和粘贴功能，而不依赖 vision 能力声明。对于不支持Vision的模型，允许将上传的图片以 普通 URL 文本插入到用户消息中，而不是以 image_url 字段发送到模型 API。

### 📝 补充信息

_No response_

linked_prs.body:
#### 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

<!-- For change type, change [ ] to [x]. -->

- [x] ✨ feat

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change
This commit implements RFC-128 Phase 1, adding complete ComfyUI integration to LobeChat with support for multiple AI image generation models.

## Key Features

### Model Support
- **FLUX Series**: Schnell (ultra-fast), Dev (high-quality), Krea-dev (safety-enhanced), Kontext-dev (image editing)
- **Stable Diffusion**: SD 1.5, SDXL, SD 3.5 (Large/Medium), Custom models
- **Image Operations**: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation
- **Flexible Parameters**: Aspect ratios, samplers, schedulers, guidance scale

### Architecture & Implementation
- **Service Layer**: Clean separation of concerns with dedicated service modules
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error system with proper error codes and i18n
- **Authentication**: Multi-auth support (none, basic, bearer, custom headers)
- **Model Resolution**: Smart model discovery and variant selection
- **Workflow System**: Modular workflow architecture for different models
- **Caching**: TTL-based cache for model lists and performance optimization

### Testing & Documentation
- **Test Coverage**: 98.41% coverage with comprehensive unit and integration tests
- **Documentation**: Complete development guide in English and Chinese
- **Type Safety**: Full TypeScript support with proper type definitions
- **Mock System**: Unified mock system for consistent testing

### Key Components
- Runtime implementation with SDK integration
- Workflow builders for FLUX and SD models
- Model resolver with automatic variant selection
- Prompt splitter with style keyword support
- Error parser with detailed error mapping
- Authentication system with multiple strategies
- Frontend settings UI with validation
- Backend async task support

This implementation provides a solid foundation for AI image generation in LobeChat, with extensible architecture for future enhancements.
<!-- Thank you for your Pull Request. Please provide a description above. -->

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information
## 代码变更概况

这不是一个小功能，而是完整的ComfyUI运行时集成。代码量说明问题 - 这是一次架构级别的扩展。

### 1.5版本基础（0→1.5阶段成果）
- 基础模型运行时框架
- 简单的provider接口
- 基本错误处理
- 初步的异步支持

### 2.0版本升级（新交付）

## 一、核心运行时扩展

### 服务层架构（packages/model-runtime/src/comfyui/services/）
```
新增5个核心服务：
├── comfyuiClient.ts      # ComfyUI API客户端封装（397行）
├── errorHandler.ts       # 统一错误处理服务（122行）
├── imageService.ts       # 图像生成业务逻辑（214行）
├── modelResolver.ts      # 模型解析与验证（279行）
└── workflowBuilder.ts    # 工作流构建协调器（87行）
```

**从1.5到2.0的提升**：
- **1.5**: 简单的API调用
- **2.0**: 完整的服务分层，职责分离，依赖注入

### 错误处理体系升级（packages/model-runtime/src/comfyui/errors/）
```
7个专用错误类：
├── base.ts               # 基础错误类（ComfyUIInternalError）
├── configError.ts        # 配置错误
├── workflowError.ts      # 工作流错误
├── utilsError.ts         # 工具类错误
├── servicesError.ts      # 服务层错误
├── modelResolverError.ts # 模型解析错误
└── typeGuards.ts         # 类型守卫
```

**从1.5到2.0的提升**：
- **1.5**: 通用错误捕获
- **2.0**: 分层错误体系，精确错误定位，用户友好提示

## 二、工作流引擎（全新能力）

### 工作流实现（packages/model-runtime/src/comfyui/workflows/）
```
5个生产级工作流：
├── flux-dev.ts           # FLUX高质量20步（243行）
├── flux-schnell.ts       # FLUX快速4步（174行）
├── flux-kontext.ts       # FLUX企业28步（299行）
├── sd35.ts              # SD3.5标准流程（275行）
└── simple-sd.ts         # 通用SD适配器（359行）
```

**架构特点**：
- 静态JSON工作流定义，复制粘贴友好
- 动态参数注入策略，而非硬编码
- 智能组件解析，适应不同配置

### 工作流设计巧思
每个工作流采用"配置复制友好"设计：
```typescript
// 静态workflow对象（直接从ComfyUI导出）
const workflow = {
  '1': { class_type: 'DualCLIPLoader', inputs: {...} },
  '2': { class_type: 'UNETLoader', inputs: {...} }
};

// 参数注入（在工作流文件内完成）
workflow['5'].inputs.clip_l = clipLPrompt;
workflow['4'].inputs.width = width;

// PromptBuilder配置
const builder = new PromptBuilder(workflow);
```

## 三、配置与注册表系统

### 模型注册表（config/）
```
├── fluxModelRegistry.ts   # FLUX全系列映射（843行，107个variants）
├── sdModelRegistry.ts     # SD系列映射（508行）
├── modelRegistry.ts       # 统一注册表接口（105行）
└── systemComponents.ts    # 系统组件配置（385行）
```

**生产级特性**：
- 107个FLUX模型variants支持
- 优先级管理（Priority 1-4）
- 智能dtype推荐（default/fp8_e4m3fn/fp16）
- 模型家族识别（FLUX/SD1/SDXL/SD3）

### 智能模型解析
ModelResolverService实现三级缓存策略：
```typescript
class ModelResolverService {
  private modelCache: Map<string, string> = new Map();    // 模型映射缓存
  private vaeCache: string[] | null = null;                // VAE列表缓存
  private componentCache: Map<string, string[]> = new Map(); // 组件缓存
}
```


## 技术实现要点

### 1. 认证系统

- 集成JWT token认证流程
- 支持用户名/密码和token两种认证方式
- 认证状态持久化存储

### 2. 错误处理

- `comfyuiErrorParser.ts` (292行) - 解析ComfyUI特定错误
- 区分网络错误、认证错误、工作流错误
- 用户友好的错误信息展示

### 3. 模型兼容性

- 自动检测服务器可用模型
- 动态工作流生成基于检测结果
- 回退机制处理模型不存在情况

## 测试覆盖

**新增测试文件：**

- 工作流测试：5个测试文件，覆盖各模型工作流
- 工具类测试：7个测试文件，覆盖核心工具函数
- 集成测试：主入口测试1889行，覆盖完整流程

## 文档交付

- **开发文档**: `comfyui-development.mdx`
- **用户文档**: `comfyui.zh-CN.mdx`- 完整使用指南
- **环境变量文档**: 更新模型提供商配置说明

## 配置更新

### Docker支持

4个Dockerfile更新，添加ComfyUI相关环境变量和依赖。

## 架构影响

这次集成扩展了整个模型运行时架构：

- 新增完整的ComfyUI提供商类型定义
- 扩展了异步任务系统支持图像生成  
- 更新了错误处理框架
- 集成了标准参数系统


## 当前技术债：
1. `PromptBuilder` 没有给服务层封装，业务直接调用 SDK
目前的决策原因：因为还不清楚社区想要怎么样快捷的维护自定义的 workflow，后续的 discover 模块怎么发展，是否会接入 workflow template，所以暂时先没做，否则会产生很严重的向后兼容技术债

2. `Client` 没有严格拆分模块

linked_prs.body:
#### 💻 变更类型 | Change Type

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

- 根据[官方文档](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/function-calling)调整响应使用 `{ functionResponse: { name: tool_call.name, response: { result } }` 格式
- functionCall 的 role 修改为 `model`
- 已经存在 tool_calls (已经调用过 FunctionCall) 时，也需要声明 `tools`，否则，会导致后续调用不正常
- 生成 `ToolCallId` 添加随机数，解决多次调用与响应不匹配的问题，解决后续 functionResponse 无法正确返回的问题

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

使用 Gemini + Function Call(联网搜索/MCP...) 时，经常会出现调用 tool 出错。开始以为是模型问题，后来试了不管是 2.5 Flash-Lite 、2.5-Flash 还是 2.5 Pro 都会报错。

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

issues.title: Reasoning Effort option missing from Model Settings, causing agent errors
issues.body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

server db(lobe-chat-database image)

### 📌 Version

v1.90.4

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

The "**Reasoning Effort**" option is no longer visible in the Model Settings regardless of which model is selected. It appears only for a very limited set of models (e.g., ChatGPT), and only directly within the chat interface not in the main model settings panel. For models like DeepSeek-R1, Gemini, etc., the setting is completely unavailable.

This causes a major problem: I have multiple agents configured with default reasoning levels like "DeepThink," and now when I switch to a model that doesn't support it, the agent throws an error saying "This model does not support deep thinking." There's no way to disable or change the reasoning effort from settings as before.

The issue persists across all environments:

**Desktop Firefox and Chrome (Ubuntu)**
**Mobile device (Firefox, Chrome, Galaxy Browser)**

Self-hosted using Docker database deployment (which I always keep updated to the latest version immediately upon release)

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. Open LobeChat (Docker db image).
2. Access to Model Settings from saved agent.
3. Reasoning Effort no longer appear at all (normally apear right after **max token lim** option)
4. Use an agent that was Reasoning effort enabled, and use a non deepthink model.
5. Chat throws an error that the model does not support reasoning effort, with no way to turn it off (disable).

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

The "Reasoning Effort" option should be accessible from the Model Settings panel for all models, even if it's disabled or the current model for this agent don't have thinking feature.

There should be a clear UI option to disable or modify reasoning effort per model, especially to avoid runtime errors with agents that default to unsupported settings.

### 📝 Additional Information

Issue happens on all devices and platforms I tested.

My setup uses the official Docker image, updated regularly.

Previously, this option was always visible in settings, regardless of the selected model.

This regression affects the usability of multi-agent workflows significantly.

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

issues.title: [Request] 为 o4-mini、o3 和 o3-pro 添加 `web_search_preview` 工具启用选项
issues.body:
### 🥰 需求描述

目前 OpenAI 官方已在 Responses API 中支持通过 `web_search_preview` 工具进行互联网搜索（参考：[https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses) ），并在 PR #8131 中为部分模型实现了该功能。

但 `o4-mini`、`o3`、`o3-pro` 三款模型尚未在主分支中正式开放此选项。我们希望能够在这三款模型的 Chat Completion 和 Responses 调用中新增一个配置，使其也能启用 `web_search_preview` 工具，从而在 ChatGPT 对话中直接获得互联网范围的高质量搜索结果。

### 🧐 解决方案


* 在模型配置中为 `o4-mini`、`o3`、`o3-pro` 三款模型添加 `search: true` 能力标记。
* 在 `chatCompletion.handlePayload` 和 `responses.handlePayload` 中，检测到上述模型时将 `enabledSearch` 强制设为 `true`，并在 `tools` 数组中注入：

  ```json
  {
    "type": "web_search_preview",
    "search_context_size": "<low|medium|high>"
  }
  ```
* 确保 `pruneReasoningPayload` 或其他清理逻辑不会移除新增的 `tools`，并更新相关类型定义以支持此对象结构。
* 增加相应的单元测试和集成测试，确保新选项可以正常生效且兼容现有流程。

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e33ede48-96aa-4774-a153-684234de2843)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd78cd2f-66af-4c4f-b4fa-6b3f299c0182)

### 📝 补充信息


* 已在 Draft PR #8288 中完成最低限度的 POC 实现，代码可在该分支预览。
* 该 POC 尚未涵盖完整的错误处理、边界检测、性能优化及安全性评估，不适合作为生产环境代码。
* 后续工作需完善：

  * 类型定义及接口契约校正
  * 异常场景处理与日志记录
  * 单元测试与集成测试覆盖
  * 性能和安全性评估
* 参考文档：

  * OpenAI Web Search 工具指南：[https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=responses)
  * 相关草稿 PR：#8288

issues.title: [Request] 请求支持基于音频/视频文件内容与多模态模型对话
issues.body:
### 🥰 需求描述

当前知识库支持上传音频、视频格式的文件，不过在与多模态的大模型对话时（比如Doubao-Seed-1.6-flash, Gemini-2.5-Pro等等支持解析视频内容的模型）无法让模型使用或者解析视频内容。

### 🧐 解决方案

以下是火山方舟官方给出的api 调用示例：
“
import os
from openai import OpenAI

# 请确保您已将 API Key 存储在环境变量 ARK_API_KEY 中
# 初始化Ark客户端，从环境变量中读取您的API Key
client = OpenAI(
    # 此为默认路径，您可根据业务所在地域进行配置
    base_url="https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3",
    # 从环境变量中获取您的 API Key。此为默认方式，您可根据需要进行修改
    api_key=os.environ.get("ARK_API_KEY"),
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    # 指定您创建的方舟推理接入点 ID，此处已帮您修改为您的推理接入点 ID
    model="ep-20250708100843-4rgpf",
    messages=[
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {
                    "type": "image_url",
                    "image_url": {
                        "url": "https://ark-project.tos-cn-beijing.ivolces.com/images/view.jpeg"
                    },
                },
                {"type": "text", "text": "这是哪里？"},
            ],
        }
    ],
)

print(response.choices[0])
”

以下是谷歌官方给出的api 调用示例(上传视频）：
“
from google import genai
import time

client = genai.Client()
# Video clip (CC BY 3.0) from https://peach.blender.org/download/
myfile = client.files.upload(file=media / "Big_Buck_Bunny.mp4")
print(f"{myfile=}")

# Poll until the video file is completely processed (state becomes ACTIVE).
while not myfile.state or myfile.state.name != "ACTIVE":
    print("Processing video...")
    print("File state:", myfile.state)
    time.sleep(5)
    myfile = client.files.get(name=myfile.name)

result = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-2.0-flash", contents=[myfile, "Describe this video clip"]
)
print(f"{result.text=}")
”

以下是谷歌官方给出的api 调用示例(上传音频）：
“
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
myfile = client.files.upload(file=media / "sample.mp3")

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

linked_prs.title: ✨ feat: add NewAPI as a router provider for multi-model aggregation
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
- Added NewAPI as a new router provider to support multiple AI service aggregation
- Implemented intelligent model routing based on provider detection
- Added pricing information support with automatic conversion to USD/million tokens format

## Implementation Details

### Core Features
- **Router Provider Pattern**: Implemented using `createRouterRuntime` similar to AiHubMix
- **Three-tier Priority Routing**:
  1. `supported_endpoint_types` field (highest priority)
  2. `owned_by` field parsing
  3. Model name detection (fallback)
- **Instance-level Route Caching**: Using IIFE closure pattern to avoid global state pollution
- **Pricing Support**: Fetches pricing from `/api/pricing` endpoint and converts to LobeChat format

### Technical Improvements
- **Concurrency Safety**: Wrapped implementation in IIFE to isolate `modelRouteMap` per instance
- **Correct Endpoint Configuration**:
  - Anthropic: `/v1` (auto-converts to `/v1/messages`)
  - Google/Gemini: `/v1beta`
  - xAI: `/v1` (standard OpenAI format)
- **Pricing Conversion Formula**: `model_ratio × $2/1M tokens`

## Known Issues / TODOs
- **Per-request pricing** (`quota_type === 1`) is not supported yet, only token-based pricing is implemented
- **Model capabilities** detection relies on `processMultiProviderModelList` utility, actual provider-specific capabilities from NewAPI are not exposed in the data structure

## Related Issues
This PR addresses the following issues related to NewAPI/OneAPI support:

### Primary Issues (Direct NewAPI Support Requests)
- Fixes #8930 - New API 渠道的FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]模型无法使用
- Fixes #8668 - 使用NEW-api无法使用,但是使用其他客户端是没有问题!
- Fixes #8120 - 升级1.93.0之后NewAPi做了Proxy的模型开始报404了
- Fixes #5855 - Gemini使用OneApi提供商配置在OpenAi中上传图片报错

### Related Feature Requests
- Partially addresses #5217 - 增加通过接口及密钥调用的时候自动识别可用模型的功能
- Partially addresses #6975 - 部署时通过.env添加自定义模型服务商
- Partially addresses #7468 - 模型列表 - 自动更新并添加本渠道所有模型
- Partially addresses #8714 - 模型的能力未能自动设置

### Model Routing & Provider Issues
- May help with #8230 - 更新后中转api报错
- May help with #7997 - 流式输出时 有概率一直重复输出最后的token
- May help with #6953 - 新版本的AI Provider切换时经常数据错乱

## Related Links
- NewAPI Project: https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/new-api
- Similar implementation: AiHubMix router provider

## Related RFC
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/8953

---

This PR adds support for NewAPI, a popular multi-model aggregation service widely used in the Chinese AI community. It allows users to access multiple AI providers through a single endpoint with unified authentication and billing.

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves the usage of an LLM model (FLUX.1 Kontext) and its integration via an API, which aligns with the "Unsupported models" and "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-categories under "Incompatibility with LLM providers".

Unknown name \"frequency_penalty\": Cannot find field.", "status": "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "details": [ { "@type": "type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.BadRequest", "fieldViolations": [ { "description": "Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name \"frequency_penalty\": Cannot find field." } ] } ] } } ] ``` 删除`frequency_penalty`字段后可正常响应数据。 ### 🚦 Expected Behavior LobeChat 应该能够成功向兼容 OpenAI 格式的 Gemini API 发送请求，并正常接收和显示模型的响应。理想情况下，LobeChat 在发送请求前可以移除或忽略掉目标服务不支持的参数。 ### 📝 Additional Information 需要需要在lobe添加多个geimin服务商的源，但lobehub现在自定义服务商暂时没提供gemini格式； 就使用了gemini官方的OpenAI兼容格式，但在lobehub中发送了多余参数，gemini格式的服务也对请求参数要求严格； 解决方案建议：在LobeChat的请求构建逻辑中增加一个判断。当用户使用的是gemini兼容OpenAI模式时（可能需要增加一个额外的设置），在最终的请求体中移除frequency_penalty和presence_penalty这两个字段。 这样既能确保对 Gemini API 的兼容性，也不会影响现有对 OpenAI 或其他完全兼容 API 的使用。

issues.title: [Request] 能否支持设置助手的默认话题
issues.body:
### 🥰 需求描述

每次点击助手图标，都会默认进入一个全新的、不带上下文的“临时话题”。

在实际使用中，我发现这个设定在某些场景下会影响操作的流畅性：

1. **对于连续性任务的助手**：当我使用一个需要长期记录和追溯上下文的助手时（例如“工作日志”），我希望每次点开它都能直接回到上一次的对话界面，而不是一个空白的临时话题。目前，我需要先进入临时话题，再从话题列表中手动找到之前的话题。

2. **在多个助手间频繁切换时**：有时我会在一个主任务的对话中，临时切换到其他助手（如翻译、查询）来完成一个独立的、不想污染当前上下文的任务。当我完成并返回主任务助手时，同样需要重新在列表中找到刚才的话题并点开。

### 🧐 解决方案

能够针对具体助手，将某个已有的话题设置为默认话题，这样点开助手就可以继续上次的上下文进行对话了。

修复 qwen-image-edit 模型在处理 `imageUrls` 参数时的转换问题。

**问题描述：**
- qwen-image-edit 模型通过 NewAPI 或直接 qwen provider 调用时出现 "Unknown error occurred during image generation" 错误

2. **修复变量命名冲突：** 解决 TypeScript TS2451 错误
   - 重命名返回值变量：imageUrl → resultImageUrl
   - 重命名异步返回变量：imageUrl → generatedImageUrl

3. **完善测试覆盖：** 新增 5 个测试用例
   - imageUrls 数组转换测试
   - 多元素数组使用首元素测试  
   - 空数组错误处理测试
   - imageUrl 优先级测试
   - 参数缺失错误处理测试

**影响范围：**
- 仅影响 qwen-image-edit 模型
- 向后兼容，不破坏现有功能
- 支持 NewAPI 和直接 qwen provider 两种调用方式

- 所有 20 个测试用例通过（15 个原有 + 5 个新增）

Closes #9340

issues.title: Detecting tool support in OpenRouter
issues.body:
### 📦 Platform

Official Cloud, Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

client db (lobe-chat image)

### 📌 Version

1.136.4

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

I believe there's an issue with the way tool support is determined for OpenRouter models.

It seems we currently use the API at `https://openrouter.ai/api/frontend/models` to get the models.
This endpoint is undocumented and it appears that OpenRouter use it specifically for their website's [model comparator](https://openrouter.ai/compare).
Lobe Chat uses a field from this API called `supports_tool_parameters` to determine if tools are supported in a model:

```json
"endpoint": {
  "supports_tool_parameters": false
}
```

But the issue is that the `endpoint` field only returns capabilities of the first provider for a model.

For example, the first provider for `deepseek-r1-0528` is _Chutes_ and it doesn't support tools for the model.
But the forth provider for `deepseek-r1-0528` is _SiliconFlow_ and is does support tools for the same model.

The result is that `deepseek-r1-0528` is detected in Lobe Chat as a model without tool support (unless a user manually re-enable it).

---

However OpenRouter actually provides a documented API for this exact purpose.
It's located at `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models` and documented [here](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/list-available-models).
It also doesn't require authentication to use.

This API is well aware that `deepseek-r1-0528` support tools:

```json
"supported_parameters": [
  "frequency_penalty",
  "include_reasoning",
  "logit_bias",
  "logprobs",
  "max_tokens",
  "min_p",
  "presence_penalty",
  "reasoning",
  "repetition_penalty",
  "response_format",
  "seed",
  "stop",
  "structured_outputs",
  "temperature",
  "tool_choice",
  "tools",
  "top_k",
  "top_logprobs",
  "top_p"
]
```

The `tools` parameter indicates that the model support tools.
This is actually specifically called out in the docs:

> Note: `supported_parameters` is a union of all parameters supported by all providers for this model.

I think this API is the suitable source to get this kind of data instead of what's currently used.

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Fetch up-to-date models from OpenRouter.

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

Models would be tagged with their actual capabilities supported on OpenRouter.

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_

#### 📝 Additional Information

这个问题出现的原因是：之前的代码逻辑中，没有把联网搜索能力存到数据库，如果用户手动获取了模型列表或者手动更改了某个模型的配置后，数据库中联网搜索能力是缺失的。但是在对话页面，判断模型是否有联网搜索能力，是通过搜索参数来判断的，这就导致了模型没有显示搜索能力，但是可以使用模型内置搜索，如 #8760 #8099。

pr #9022 修改之后，在对话页面中，删去了没有搜索能力模型的搜索参数，这就导致了之前版本中，由手动获取模型列表或更改模型配置导致的搜索能力缺失的模型，同步删去了搜索参数，导致对话时判断没有内置搜索引擎，没有选择内置搜索的选项。

此pr合并后，删去搜索参数的逻辑改为只有在数据库中显式声明`"search": false`，才会删去。而老版数据库中，模型能力没有`"search"`字段，不会再删去搜索参数，兼容老版本。

- fix #9756

Fix search settings handling to respect explicit model search ability flags and maintain backward compatibility

- Only remove search settings when a model’s abilities.search is explicitly false to prevent unintended loss of built-in search options
- Preserve search settings for legacy models missing the abilities.search field to restore built-in search functionality
